description: M0 bootstrap: control files, feasibility audit and draft protocol created. No experiment run.

M2 core implementation committed at 2059ba7: seeded schedule (JS and Python twins), mock page, Playwright harness on installed Chrome 158.0.8127.38, metrics, stats, schemas, manifests, runner, report generator, CLI. Two defects found by the first smoke check and fixed before commit: the page passed a stream id instead of a stream name to the schedule (every trial timed out); page errors did not fail the session.

EXP-001 matrix run as an EXPLORATORY pre-freeze run (seeds 1001-1005). Not a finding. Machine shared with other agents: load average 25.31/34.98/22.02 at start, 3.14/8.87/14.17 at end; timings are noisy.

M3 smoke check (exploratory, seed 1001, experiments/smoke.json) before any confirmatory run. Code 7c8f7d1 plus the uncommitted inference module (manifest dirty flag true). Chrome 158.0.8127.38 headless. 5 sessions, 10/10 trials ok, 7.2 s. Load average 1.67/4.77/13.44 at start, mains power.

EXP-001 rerun as the M3 metric validation on exploratory seeds 1001-1005 (disjoint from confirmatory seeds), quiet window, under nice -n 10. Not a finding. Code 7c8f7d1 plus the uncommitted inference module (dirty flag true). Chrome 158.0.8127.38. Load average 1.98/4.69/13.26 at start (falling after the SCALE timing runs), 1.27/1.85/7.05 at end; mains power. Checks on known cases: C1 pass (no BLANK trial below the injected delay; minimum excess 3.2 ms), C2 pass (cell median excess 12.0 to 27.0 ms, below 50 ms), C3 pass (final state correct in 200/200 write trials), C4 pass (prefetch used in 50/50 trials); no defect flags; stop rule not triggered. One A3 exclusion (S0002, BLANK read L=100, k=4: measured lead 178.8 ms), 1 of 25 trials in that group. The inference module ran on this output (exploratory; no verdict is drawn).
